DECLARE @hasParentTran BIT
DECLARE @apptId INT
DECLARE @currProfileConfigId INT = 16
DECLARE @taskDefId INT
DECLARE @taskDesc VARCHAR(200)
DECLARE @dueDate DATETIME
DECLARE @caseId INT
DECLARE @apptTypeConfigId INT
DECLARE @userId INT
DECLARE @teamId INT
DECLARE @apptStatusReasonConfigId INT
DECLARE @apptStatusConfigId INT 


--find all appts that is about to happen (in 1-2 days) and generate appt-reminder tasks so workers can call the members and confirm their appts
DECLARE CursorAppt CURSOR FOR
SELECT A.apptId
FROM [Case].vwAppt A
WHERE A.apptStatusConfigId = 196 --196=scheduled
	AND CONVERT(DATE, A.apptStart) > CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) --apptdate is in the future
	AND 
		((DATEDIFF(DAY, CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()), CONVERT(DATE, A.apptStart)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2) --apptdate is about to happen in 1 or 2 days 
		OR 
		(DATEDIFF(DAY, CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()), CONVERT(DATE, A.apptStart)) = 3 --or apptdate is monday and today is friday
			AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY, GETDATE()) = 6 --6=friday
			AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY, A.apptStart) = 2)) --2=monday
	AND NOT EXISTS --apptreminder task has not yet been created for this appt
		(SELECT 1 
		FROM [Case].Task T
		WHERE T.taskDefId = 29
			AND T.caseId = A.caseId
			AND T.apptId = A.apptId)

OPEN CursorAppt
FETCH NEXT FROM CursorAppt INTO @apptId

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

	BEGIN TRY

		--if no outer tran started, start tran 
		IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN 
			SET @hasParentTran = 0; 
			BEGIN TRAN; 
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN 
			SET @hasParentTran = 1; 
		END
		
		SELECT
			@userId = A.userId,
			@caseId = A.caseId,
			@apptTypeConfigId = A.apptTypeConfigId,
			@apptStatusReasonConfigId=A.apptStatusReasonConfigId,
			@apptStatusConfigId = A.apptStatusConfigId
		FROM [Case].Appt A
		INNER JOIN [Case].MemberCase C ON C.caseId = A.caseId
		WHERE A.apptId = @apptId

		--get user's default team
		SET @teamId = [User].fnGetDefaultTeamId(@currProfileConfigId, @userId)

		--calculate duedate based from today 
		SELECT 
			@taskDefId = T.taskDefId,
			@dueDate = DATEADD(DAY, ISNULL(T.dueInDays,0), GETDATE()),
			@taskDesc = RTRIM(T.taskName) + ' [Appt ID:' + LTRIM(@apptId) + ']' --taskDesc will be something like    Appt Reminder [Appt ID: 123]
		FROM Task.TaskDef T
		WHERE T.profileConfigId = @currProfileConfigId
			AND T.taskDefId = 29

		EXEC [Case].prMaintainTask 
			@currUserId = 1,
			@currProfileConfigId=@currProfileConfigId,
			@mode='A',
			@caseId=@caseId,
			@apptId=@apptId,
			@taskDefId=@taskDefId,
			@taskDesc=@taskDesc,
			@taskStatusConfigId=113, --113=open
			@taskStatusReasonConfigId=120, --120=intialize
			@userId=@userId, 
			@teamId=@teamId,
			@dueDate=@dueDate,
			@silent=1

		--no problem found, if no outer tran, commit
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0 AND @hasParentTran = 0)
		BEGIN 
			COMMIT; 
		END;	
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		--problem occurred; if no outer tran, rollback this tran (and its child trans)
		IF (@@TRANCOUNT > 0)
		BEGIN 
		--rollback above transactions then create log
			ROLLBACK; 
			--create an error log
			INSERT App.[Log](logTypeConfigId, logDateTime, userId, logNotes, sqlProcedure, sqlErrorNumber, sqlerrorMessage)
			SELECT 
				434, --sqlexception
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				logNotes = 
				'apptId=' + LTRIM(@apptId),
				'Generate Appt Reminder Task SSIS Script',
				SUBSTRING(LTRIM(ERROR_NUMBER()), 1, 50),
				SUBSTRING(LTRIM(ERROR_MESSAGE()), 1, 8000)
		END; 
		--THROW; --dont bubble up; comment this out because loop should continute even when 1 recordline has error

	END CATCH;

	--if it got here, task-generation and update of appt is successful, so update the status of the appt

	FETCH NEXT FROM CursorAppt INTO @apptId	
END
CLOSE CursorAppt
DEALLOCATE CursorAppt
